[*] Adjusted the visual shader applied on interactable items.

Create original item and Falcon skins and submit them this year to enter the event.
The most popular entries will be eligible to be integrated into the game as new items.
Vote on your favorite skins by using the thumbs up button on their page.

As always, thanks a lot for your support.

notes.title: Release Date Delay Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36038541/fd86c23d4e978d0f61418d8c7bdf0d48c32c8e23.png[/img]


Hello everyone, Metal Unit team here with an important announcement.

We have made a very difficult decision to postpone the official release date of Metal Unit. We don’t feel comfortable promising you guys a set date just yet, but we think we’ll be able to do so within January, 2021. 

We want to apologize to our fans who were eagerly looking forward to our game’s official release. Postponing our 1.0 launch was definitely not an easy call for us to make but we feel was ultimately the right choice for the game. Our utmost priority is delivering you the best possible version of Metal Unit. That’s why we decided to take the time needed to polish, add more contents and implement more changes based on user feedback into our game. We sincerely hope that you’ll understand where we’re coming from.

That being said, we think that it’s only fair we give you guys a sneak peek of some of the changes that will be made for launch! 

* We thought that the last chapter of Metal Unit needed a stronger impression as it is the highlight of the game. Therefore, we are working on a complete overhaul of the three mini-bosses in the last chapter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36038541/c703b752a2d6596ce56eacba829894e820658a7c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36038541/b598a63a80e2f9e533824547df916a0f9845f156.gif[/img]

* There are a lot of interactive objects in the base where Joanna starts her adventure. Among them, there is a museum under construction. We’re developing this museum to be a place that displays all the data you’ve collected during your gameplay. This’ll be another achievement that true fans can strive to complete! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36038541/0c3f9690e5d34777cf39ad9effb8a27fd1ba1dd5.png[/img]

Aside from those, we are working on numerous visual improvements throughout the game. We also want you to know that we’re planning to make additional contents even after our official launch based on community events & feedback.


We hope you understand the difficult decision we have made for Metal Unit. We look forward to your continued interest and support for Metal Unit.

Thank you!

notes.title: Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36038541/07dba201b3926db8633883204374d5d60635024a.png[/img]

Hello Everyone,

This is the Metal Unit Development Team.

First of all, we'd like to thank the whole Metal Unit Community for all of your support and feedback. It goes without saying that we've learned a lot over the past week thanks to your questions and comments. 

So to show our gratitude for your help and to reward your interest in our game, we'd like to share the following major updates with you. Please note that we'll have many other smaller updates going forward as well.

As for the timeline, we're hoping to complete everything listed below by the end of this month (February).

[h3]Adding Chapter 4
[/h3]
The new level added will be the Lava Chapter. Just like the name suggests, this chapter will be filled with lava and feature several new monsters. But that doesn't matter to Joanna,  she's focused on her mission.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36038541/f056adc4b681fbafade13a66afa2602ecff2e042.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36038541/c95234372ae114ec6d6af3ff4697ee0fc45c7e1f.png[/img]

There will also be a new campground and dungeon added that match the overall concept of the Lava Chapter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36038541/44095c6ffdc3a143e17a0c1d337b1002c4f68729.png[/img]

Pray for a special item after your adventure!

[h3]Adding an Upgrade System[/h3]
Through the new upgrade system, players will be able to acquire a wide variety of helpful skills.

We received a lot of feedback in regards to Metal Unit being rather difficult for some players, so we think this upgrade system will help lower the difficulty level to a certain degree.

[h3]New Boss![/h3]
Once you've cleared the main story boss once, you're not done yet. You'll find another boss waiting for you once you re-enter the game. For example, once you've cleared the Dragon boss in the Forest Chapter, you'll find something altogether different the next time you visit.

As for the Snow Chapter, there still isn't a different boss that appears after you've cleared the level once, but this will be added soon. The same goes for the Lava Chapter which will be added in the near future.

[h3]Steam Achievements, Trading Cards & Badges[/h3]
We're going to be adding a bunch more Achievements in addition to the temporary ones currently in place. Trading Cards and Badges are also in the works.

[h3]Playability & Balancing[/h3]
We are paying close attention to everything you have to say and are working tirelessly to improve the game's overall playability and balancing. Your feedback is super helpful and we'll do our best to reflect your opinions/ideas in future versions of the game.

We're checking all of your comments around-the-clock, so please let us know your thoughts!

Steam Community : https://steamcommunity.com/app/1173200/discussions/
Official Discord : https://discord.gg/AzpY29t
Official Email : metalunit_support@neowiz.com

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36038541/2d67eca13bed41797a7a6aa648f8951a6709ee31.png[/img]

[h3][b]Full-Version Launch in Q2 2020[/b][/h3]
After updating the game this month and testing its overall stability, Chapter 5 (the Deep Lava Chapter) will be added. This chapter will include the game's ending and is the absolute best part of Metal Unit!

After updating the Deep Lava Chapter, we plan to focus on the game's balancing and ultimately deliver the full version of Metal Unit by the end of 2Q 2020.

notes.title: Metal Unit Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36038541/17b5abfc6d52581da95a251ef0724333cc9d8e68.jpg[/img]
Hello!

First of all, we would like to thank everyone for their continued support of Metal Unit. We've been working tirelessly trying to get the game ready for Early Access. Please see below for some major updates~

[h2][b]Early Access Starts on February 4th (KST)[/b][/h2]
We've decided to do Early Access to gather as much feedback as possible to improve the game. While we're doing our best to get the game fully completed, we need your help and insight to put the finishing touches on it and make it the best game it can be.

Also please note that we have Discord, Twitter and Facebook pages up and running for Metal Unit. If you find any bugs or would like to provide some feedback regarding the game, please feel free to share your thoughts through any of those channels. And as always, any support/advice you can provide would be greatly appreciated and help get us that much closer to officially releasing the game.

[h3][b]'Creator Beta Test' Drawing to a Close[/b][/h3]
We've decided to conclude the beta test on January 20th. Although the exact time we will shut it down varies due to time zone differences. Just note that you won't be able to use play the beta version anymore starting on the 21st. 

If you haven't gotten the chance to share any bugs you found or opinions you would like to share, please post them on our Discord. We'll do our best to reflect everything in future versions of the game.
[url=https://discord.gg/AzpY29t][Discord for Beta Test][/url] ☜ Click~!

[h3][b]Feedback from the 'Curator Beta Test'[/b][/h3]
Since starting the beta testing on December 30th, we've received an overwhelming amount of support from everyone and for that we're very grateful. We've taken your feedback to heart and are doing everything we can to turn your suggestions into a reality. Check out below for some examples of what we're working on.

[b]1. Game Balancing and Optimization[/b]
We received a lot of feedback regarding Metal Unit's current balancing/difficulty level and we are hard at work trying to make the game as fair as possible. This is something that we will continue to perfect even after the game's official release since it is such an important aspect of gameplay. We're also working on beefing up the tutorial to make the game's initial learning curve a little less steep.

[b]2. Polishing the Game Contents[/b]
Metal Unit being a platformer, making the movement and attack/evade actions as smooth as possible is extremely important. And after reviewing the feedback from the beta testing we found that it's taking people longer than expected to get used to the controls. So for this reason we've decided to add several tutorials to the game to clearly show all of the capabilities at your disposal and how to effectively use them. Once we're done with this process, the controls should be much more satisfying and intuitive to use. This is definitely going to have a very positive impact on the gameplay, so you can look forward to this.

[b]3. Fixing All Confirmed Bugs[/b]
As you all know, bugs can really destroy a game's immersion and ruin the experience. So during the beta testing we spent most of our time and resources fixing any game-breaking bugs that were found. And we're going to do our best to have as many more bugs fixed before EA starts as we can, and that also should have a big effect on gameplay.

Once again, we would like to thank everyone who participated in our beta testing. Your support keeps us motivated and your feedback keeps us focused. We can't wait to show you how far the game has come on February 4th, so stay tuned!
